description: Labelled retrieval questions over the public document corpus (Phase 5). Relevance labels (document + PDF pages) and evidence phrases were taken from the extracted chunks and checked against the source PDF pages. A retrieved passage is RELEVANT if its document matches and its page range overlaps the labelled pages; it is ANSWER-BEARING if it also contains at least one evidence phrase (case-insensitive). Negative questions have no answer in the corpus.
